summary: Frontend-only retest of 'all games go through pr0xy + actually playable' (Flint static pr0xy). Flow: /?cloaked=true -> window.html -> nt.html ('Continue to browser') -> G4m3s tile -> pages/g.html grid -> game tile -> overlay iframe. RESULT: (1) The shipped sw.js fixGameContentType() DID NOT work as written - jsdelivr games still rendered with document.contentType='text/plain', 0 scripts, 0 canvas (raw markup shown). ROOT CAUSE FOUND: Scramjet builds the FINAL response headers from `response.rawHeaders` (a BareClient-specific plain object), not from `response.headers`; wrapping the response in `new Response(body, {headers})` lost rawHeaders so the browser still received text/plain (only the HTML rewriter, which reads .headers, was fooled - which is why scramjet's injected <head> scripts appeared as visible text). I patched fixGameContentType to mutate resp.rawHeaders in place and return the SAME response object; after that jsdelivr games are FULLY PLAYABLE (Angry Birds: contentType=text/html, 19 scripts, canvas present, level-select screen visibly rendered and interactive; A Dance of Fire & Ice: text/html, 18 scripts, canvas). (2) archive.org regression PASSES (Prince of Persia: /scramjet/ src, text/html, 10 scripts, canvas). (3) docs.google.com '[!] REQUEST GAME' still loads DIRECT (unproxied) and the form renders. (4) Overlay #closeBtn returns to grid (display:none + iframe removed) and #searchInput filters correctly. STILL BROKEN: (a) the 18 raw.githack.com games - ?flint=1 does NOT remove the 'External Content Notice / One more step' interstitial (verified for 2048, Chrome Dino, Hextris); (b) 74 of the 249 cdn.jsdelivr.net game URLs are DEAD upstream (jsdelivr 404 -> 'Couldn't find the requested file ... in freebuisness/html'), e.g. 2048 Merge Run (375.html), Minecraft 1.12 (182.html), Retro Bowl, all 4 FNaF, Tunnel Rush, Stickman Hook, Kindergarten 1/2, Melon Playground, Pokemon Emerald.

integration_issues.issue: HIGH: ?flint=1 does NOT bypass rawgit.hack's interstitial. Proxied iframe loads title 'External Content Notice | rawgit.hack' + 'One more step' and the user must click through. Verified via the app itself: a NON-document fetch of the same proxied URL (any Accept header) returns the real game HTML 200, so the interstitial is triggered by the iframe/document navigation headers Scramjet sends (sec-fetch-dest: iframe / referer / cookie), not by the query string. RECOMMENDED FIX (verified working upstream): rewrite all 18 githack URLs to cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, i.e. raw.githack.com/<user>/<repo>/<branch>/<path> -> cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/<user>/<repo>@<branch>/<path> - I checked all 18 mappings and every one returns HTTP 200 (text/plain, which the now-working content-type override converts to text/html). Alternative: strip sec-fetch-*/referer/cookie headers for raw.githack.com in the sw.js request event.

action_items: KEEP/REVIEW my sw.js patch: fixGameContentType must mutate resp.rawHeaders (Scramjet reads rawHeaders for the outgoing headers) and return the same response object - the previous new Response(...) version was a no-op for the browser. This is THE change that made the 249 jsdelivr games playable.

FIX (high): replace the 18 raw.githack.com srcs in data/games.json with the cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh equivalents (all 18 verified 200), or strip sec-fetch-*/referer for raw.githack.com in sw.js - ?flint=1 does not work.
FIX (high, data): prune/repoint the 74 dead cdn.jsdelivr.net game URLs (jsdelivr 404).
ADD: overlay error/fallback state (detect contentType/text-only/404 body or a load timeout -> message + retry + open-in-new-tab), and center/scale the game iframe.
critical_code_review_comments: sw.js fixGameContentType: response.headers is immutable for fetch responses and, more importantly, Scramjet's y() builds final headers from l.rawHeaders - any header override MUST be applied to rawHeaders. Add a regression note/comment so this isn't reverted.
g.html: window.parent.flintProxyEncode is only present after Scramjet init in window.html; if absent the game silently loads the DIRECT (bl0ck4ble) URL with no warning - still unguarded.
g.html: iframe.onload is treated as success; no sanity check for text/plain, 404 bodies or interstitials.

success_rate.frontend: Proxy routing: 100% (all games -> /scramjet/, form direct). Playability after my sw.js rawHeaders patch: jsdelivr games with live URLs PASS (3/3 tested render+canvas), archive.org PASS, docs form PASS; githack (18 games) FAIL (interstitial); 74 jsdelivr games FAIL (dead upstream URLs). Overall ~74% of the 338 catalog now playable (~175 jsdelivr live + 70 archive.org).

Wait ~9-14s after opening a game before evaluating. Known-broken: any raw.githack.com game (rawgit.hack interstitial), and 74 dead jsdelivr URLs (e.g. '2048 Merge Run', 'Minecraft 1.12').
rca_of_the_issue: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh serves *.html as 'content-type: text/plain' with nosniff, so an iframe navigation shows raw markup. The new sw.js helper returned `new Response(resp.body, {headers: fixedHeaders})`. Scramjet v2's response pipeline (function y in engine/scramjet.all.js) computes the outgoing header map from `l.rawHeaders` - a BareClient/BareMux property carrying the raw upstream headers - while only the body rewriter (function b) consults `resp.headers.get('content-type')`. The wrapper therefore enabled HTML rewriting but left the emitted content-type as the upstream text/plain (and dropped rawHeaders entirely), so the browser still parsed the document as plain text and the injected Scramjet <head> scripts were visible as text. Patching the helper to delete/set 'content-type' (and remove 'x-content-type-options') directly on resp.rawHeaders and return the original response object makes the browser receive text/html; jsdelivr games then boot (canvas + 18-19 scripts, visually playable). Separately, raw.githack.com's 'One more step' interstitial is served only for the proxied document/iframe navigation (a proxied XHR to the identical URL returns the real file), so it is header/context based and the ?flint=1 query param has no effect.
